meta.name: Operation Cobra 1080p
meta.description:
Terrorists organization "Radical Posture Group" get access to a new generation technology resulting from Dr. Patel's joint research between India and the UK. Only man can stop them - India's Agent Condor, known to his friends as Karan. Focusing on terrorism, Karan discovers the biggest threat comes from within the ranks of Indian intelligence, from a madman who hopes to make terrorism a global trade. That foe, and the woman he loves, threaten the safety of London with their twisted agenda - Karan has to save the day unsure he can trust anyone around him.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A new radical group threatens the existence of the world as we know it. Agent Karan Singh is called to the rescue.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A personal loss worsened by a professional setback makes Karan question his mission and his nation s loyalty to him.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: With his gusto revived, Karan and his new team hatch a plan to procure sensitive information about their mission.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Karan is backed into a corner by an enemy unknown to him. He is pushed to take drastic measures in a bid to ensure victory.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Karan learns of his new enemy. With all of his cards out on the table, his loyalty to the nation and victory is at stake.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Karan runs an exhilarating race against time that pushes him to his very limits, testing his existence as an agent and a human.
